_declared_before_results: Every threshold below was written before the first run. Do not edit them after seeing an outcome; add a new config file instead.

matched_null._purpose: Permute the cluster assignment while keeping cluster sizes fixed. If the spread of per-cluster optimal slopes is no larger than this null, the ladder is sampling noise and must not be shipped.

ship_bar._purpose: A bracket is only worth shipping if the ladder is real AND the flat arm's cost on the easy split is small relative to its modelled payoff on a shifted one.

bracket._purpose: Slopes actually emitted for submission. Anchored on the out-of-fold optimum and flattened by the measured ladder, never a point estimate.

distance_instrument._purpose: board ~= baseline + coefficient * (1 - rho_cc), the only local instrument that predicted a public score to better than 0.001 in any published solution on this task.
